Q6064.reason: If the tenant still believed the lease was in effect, possession stayed subordinate to the landlord and was never hostile, so adverse possession never began and the devisee wins ejectment.

Q6065.reason: Standard normal knee flexion ROM (AAOS and common clinical references) is 0–135 degrees; 115 is limited and 155–175 exceed typical normal range.

Q6067.reason: Rule 56 requires a sworn affidavit or declaration from a competent witness; the expert’s own affidavit creates a genuine dispute, while an unsworn report, counsel’s hearsay affidavit, and a current diagnosis do not.
